audit_items.proof_trace: The withdrawal entry points take only ObligationOwnerCap (no separate Obligation object), and pass cap.obligation_id to market.handle_withdraw, which retrieves the obligation via ObjectTable::borrow_mut(obligation_id). Because ObjectTable keys equal the stored object's own ID (set at obligations.add(object::id(&obligation), obligation)), the retrieved obligation's ID necessarily equals cap.obligation_id. The cap-obligation binding is established immutably at ObligationOwnerCap::new() via object::id(&obligation), so cap.obligation_id == obligation.id holds by construction on every code path.
